help: Write down the price of a food in a shop. The application uses it to estimate the budget of a shopping plan and the cost of a recipe for each serving. A food has one price for each shop.
empty: No price yet. Add the price of the foods that you buy often: each shopping plan will show its budget.
store-hint: Choose a shop or type another name, for example "market".
price-invalid: The price must be more than zero.
regular-price-hint: Only if the price above is a promotion.
regular-invalid: The regular price cannot be lower than the price.
size-help: Without a content, the cost cannot be computed from a weight or a volume.
size-incomplete: Give the content and its unit, or neither.
by-weight-help: The shop sells any quantity at this rate: the cost is not rounded up to a whole pack.
label: Label
label-hint: For example: spaghetti no. 5, 500 g pack
promotion-over: The promotion is over: the regular price is used

source.title: Prices read from the shops
source.disabled: The automatic reading of prices is not enabled on this server. The prices typed by hand are enough for the budget.
source.help: Search a product at Coop, Migros, Aldi or Lidl, then keep its price for a food. Only the search text and the shops go to the price service.
source.unavailable: The price service does not answer. Your stored prices stay usable.
source.keep-title: Keep the price for a food
source.refresh: Refresh the prices read from the shops
source.refresh-none: No automatically read price to refresh.

budget.title: Estimated budget
budget.help: An estimate from the prices that you stored, rounded up to whole packs. It is not a receipt.
budget.empty: No stored price for the items of this plan.
budget.best: At the best price of each item
budget.missing: {count} item without a price | {count} items without a price
budget.used: of which {amount} used by your recipes

reason.NO_FOOD: Free text: no food to price
reason.UNIT_MISMATCH: The unit does not fit the stored price
